one_liner: OpenAI's agent runtime: handoffs, guardrails, HITL RunState, MCP, sandbox agents.
best_for: OpenAI-standardized orgs needing handoffs, guardrails, sandbox code-act
when_not_to_use: Do not use as the sole stack if you require vendor-neutral ops (Traces/Sandbox/session gravity is real), or if you need open graph checkpoint export across non-OpenAI runtimes without adapters.

api_primitives.checkpoint: Sessions + RunState; Temporal/Restate integrations for durable runs
api_primitives.stream: Runner streaming events; results stream APIs
api_primitives.structured: Agent output types / structured outputs on agents
api_primitives.obs: Built-in tracing; exportable spans; guardrail hooks
